def st(res_out):
    s=res_out['observation_summary']['state']
    return s['robot_obs'], s['scene_obs']
def clip(v): return max(-1.0,min(1.0,v))
last=o
def goto(target, grip, n=40, tol=0.008):
    global last
    for i in range(n):
        ro,so=st(last)
        d=[target[j]-ro[j] for j in range(3)]
        if max(abs(x) for x in d)<tol: return True
        a=[clip(d[0]/0.02),clip(d[1]/0.02),clip(d[2]/0.02),0.0,0.0,0.0,grip]
        r=primitives.call(name='submit_calvin_action',action=a)
        if not r.ok: print('err',r.output); return False
        last=r.output
    return False
ro,so=st(last)
b=so[12:15]
print('tcp',ro[:3],'blue',b)

ro,so=st(last); print(ok1,'tcp',[round(x,3) for x in ro[:3]],'blue',[round(x,3) for x in so[12:15]])
